All spatial layers use the provisional boundary (official_boundary=false) and are self-consistent; areas recomputed from GeoJSON. Caveat: the provisional overall-design-range polygon may be offset ~412.5 m from the OSM-mapped heritage park (see issue #846); no official polygon is available, so exact siting is not claimed.

A3/A0 PDFs and visual/index.html are generated from metrics-driven tables; static, no external runtime dependency. Accessibility pre-check (keyboard/responsive) passed; a full color-blind/alt-text audit by real disabled users has not yet occurred.

Proposal cites standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions; 19 sources registered with source_type, authority_level, usable_for and not_usable_for. Caveat: no real public-participation records or disabled-user walkthrough have occurred; participation is declared as a planned mechanism, not verified evidence.
